The Lemokey P3 HE keyboard uses Gateron Double Rail Magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled. It does not support other magnetic switches, such as the Gateron Magnetic Jade or Gateron KS-20 Magnetic switches.
Adjustable Actuation Point: Customize each key with precision, adjusting actuation points from 0.2 to 3.8 mm with 0.1 mm sensitivity. Set shallow keypresses for instant actions and deeper ones for deliberate engagement, minimizing accidental touches and giving you an edge in both gaming and typing.
Dynamic Rapid Trigger: Activate or deactivate keys based on how far they travel, not predefined points. This means immediate key reactions—press to activate, release to reset—allowing for faster, more precise keystrokes. In rapid gameplay, this translates to executing complex actions in real-time without delay, giving you a serious advantage during fast-paced sequences.
Dynamic Keystrokes: Thanks to Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS), you can now assign up to 4 distinct actions per key based on press depth. A light press moves your character, a deeper press makes them run, and releasing the key enables additional commands. This layered control lets you execute multiple moves with ease, streamlining gameplay while enhancing control and speed, making your reactions quicker and more precise.
Analog Mode: Analog Mode Experience the power of Analog Mode, bringing game controller-like precision to your keyboard. This mode enables variable inputs instead of the usual on/off signals, letting you achieve more fluid and dynamic control. With each keypress, the keyboard detects how far you press, translating it into different speeds and intensities. Enjoy nuanced control and heightened responsiveness in racing games, sports simulations, and more.
Last Key Priority (LKP) and Snap Click: Prioritizes the last key pressed, allowing for seamless directional changes and ensuring smoother gameplay . With Snap Click, deeper keypresses take precedence when two keys are hit at once, automatically resetting shallower presses.
Program with Launcher: With the Keychron Launcher web app, you can effortlessly remap keys, adjust actuation points, set the magnetic switches, create personalized macro commands, shortcuts, and key combinations for each key.

Screen Theme Animations
Dynamic Island- This function primarily displays keyboard status information, supports turning on/off and resizing, but more importantly, it emphasizes DIY customization. It supports uploading multiple GIFs as foreground and background layers. You can use hotkeys to switch between foreground and background, creating your desired combinations. Both GIFs will adjust their playback speed based on your typing rhythm. You can also choose to upload only a background GIF for pure GIF display.
Cat and Dog Theme- The on-screen cat now mirrors your keystrokes in real-time—when you press a key, the cat taps the same one (with special reactions for modifier keys!). The faster you type, the more frantically the hamster at the top runs, eventually flopping down when tired, creating a highly engaging and playful experience.
Animal Supermarket- We've included an engaging typing challenge mini-game: when the "3-2-1" countdown ends, you’ll step into the role of a supermarket cashier, warmly welcoming animal customers as they come to supermarket. You need to type the correct words to help them buy items from the shopkeeper. But don’t get careless—if you make a typo, the shopkeeper will "lovingly" give you a playful slap!
3 Dot-Matrix Displays- The Dot-Matrix Display continues the 3 themes previously featured on the QK101 and QK80 Mk2.

These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled.
Rapid Trigger
Adjust actuation and reset on the fly based on travel distance rather than a fixed point. This enables faster firing, easier strafing, and more responsive control for directional or rhythm-heavy games. Great for FPS players who rely on precise movement and instant input reset.
Snap Key
The keyboard handles simultaneous key input by automatically prioritizing or neutralizing conflicting signals (SOCD). This ensures directional control stays accurate and avoids input stalls. It's especially useful in fighting games or any two-key directional input situations.
DKS
Four actions from a single key. A shallow press triggers action 1, a deeper press triggers action 2, and both the upward releases can trigger two additional actions. Ideal for macros, shortcuts or multi-functional keys where you want multiple commands mapped to the same key based on how hard or long you press.

The Keychron C0 HE 8K keyboard uses Keychron Ultra-Fast Lime magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled. The C0 HE 8K is compatible exclusively with the Keychron Ultra-fast Lime Magnetic Switch. It does not support other magnetic switches, such as the Gateron Magnetic Jade or Gateron KS-20 Magnetic switches.
TMR Magnetic Switch Features
Adjustable Actuation Point: Customize each key with precision, adjusting actuation points from 0.1 to 3.35 mm with 0.01 mm sensitivity. Set shallow keypresses for instant actions and deeper ones for deliberate engagement, minimizing accidental touches and giving you an edge in both gaming and typing.
Dynamic Rapid Trigger: Activate or deactivate keys based on how far they travel, not predefined points. This means immediate key reactions—press to activate, release to reset—allowing for faster, more precise keystrokes. In rapid gameplay, this translates to executing complex actions in real-time without delay, giving you a serious advantage during fast-paced sequences.
Dynamic Keystrokes: Thanks to Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS), you can now assign up to 4 distinct actions per key based on press depth. A light press moves your character, a deeper press makes them run, and releasing the key enables additional commands. This layered control lets you execute multiple moves with ease, streamlining gameplay while enhancing control and speed, making your reactions quicker and more precise.
Analog Mode: Analog Mode Experience the power of Analog Mode, bringing game controller-like precision to your keyboard. This mode enables variable inputs instead of the usual on/off signals, letting you achieve more fluid and dynamic control. With each keypress, the keyboard detects how far you press, translating it into different speeds and intensities. Enjoy nuanced control and heightened responsiveness in racing games, sports simulations, and more.
Program with the Keychron Launcher: With the Keychron Launcher web app, you can effortlessly remap keys, adjust actuation points, set the magnetic switches, create personalized macro commands, shortcuts, and key combinations for each key.

Using Realforce software, users can access the following settings and save their changes to the on-board memory:
- APC (Actuation Point Changer) setting: Adjust the actuation point depth of each key which can be set to 30 levels of sensitivity using 0.1mm increments ranging from 0.1mm to 3.0mm.
- Dynamic mode function: Allows you to set the key switches ON to OFF and OFF to ON operating points in increments of 0.1mm.
- Kill switch function: This function disables the simultaneous input of the A and D keys used to move the game character left and right, and only enables the input of the key pushed last. It gives the player better control over a technique called "counter strafe" that is mainly used in FPS games to get more accurate shots.

This means immediate key reactions—press to activate, release to reset—allowing for faster, more precise keystrokes. In rapid gameplay, this translates to executing complex actions in real-time without delay, giving you a serious advantage during fast-paced sequences.
Dynamic Keystrokes: Thanks to Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS), you can now assign up to 4 distinct actions per key based on press depth. A light press moves your character, a deeper press makes them run, and releasing the key enables additional commands. This layered control lets you execute multiple moves with ease, streamlining gameplay while enhancing control and speed, making your reactions quicker and more precise.
Analog Mode: Analog Mode Experience the power of Analog Mode, bringing game controller-like precision to your keyboard. This mode enables variable inputs instead of the usual on/off signals, letting you achieve more fluid and dynamic control. With each keypress, the keyboard detects how far you press, translating it into different speeds and intensities. Enjoy nuanced control and heightened responsiveness in racing games, sports simulations, and more.
Last Keystroke Prioritization (LKP): LKP allows seamless directional changes by prioritizing the last key pressed, ensuring smoother gameplay in titles like Valorant.
Snap Click: With Snap Click, deeper keypresses take precedence when two keys are hit at once, automatically resetting shallower presses.
